name: web-mcp
description: Web research tools for Claude: search (self-hosted SearXNG, paper APIs and the archive, ranked with BM25), fetch (whole pages as markdown), browser (agent-browser) and lookup (passive DNS, RDAP, certificate, Wayback, IP and vulnerability records), all archived in .web/. Needs the web-mcp binary.

binPath.title: web-mcp binary
binPath.description: Path to the web-mcp binary. Default: web-mcp on PATH.

agentBrowserPath.title: agent-browser binary
agentBrowserPath.description: Path to the agent-browser binary. Default: agent-browser on PATH.
